implementation.wrapper_freeze_policy: The final wrapper contains this preregistration's SHA-256 and is frozen separately in a subsequent launch manifest.

interpretation_rules.diagnostic_valid_only_if: Every required exactness gate passes for every case and both precisions.

fp32_candidate_gate.wording: Passing licenses only a separately preregistered FP32 historical-replay and full-cohort center-validity stage; it is not an H-QC verdict or permission to inspect endpoints.

interpretation_rules.full_output_stability_wording_requires: Both pressure and WSS center-drift relative L2 are at most 0.001 on all four cases.

pin_sufficiency_threshold.nonadditivity_warning: A sufficient pin set is an intervention result; componentwise causal shares may not be added or inferred from pin differences.

interpretation_rules.query_route_is_practically_negligible_fo: Primary encoded source at fixed normalized queries differs from primary by relative L2 at most 0.001 on all four cases and both precisions.
interpretation_rules.saved_pipeline_normal_field_is_null_if: Zeroing it in primary and copying primary into fixed are bitwise null for pressure and WSS on every case and precision.
